dict.string: Daily 06:00 EDT refresh of the OFAC SDN digital-currency-address snapshot (ofac_sdn_addresses.json). Wrapper handles env source + Perl-alarm timeout belt + walker_health writes (cadence 86400s, pager alarms at 3x = 72h). RunAtLoad FALSE — a login after the scheduled hour won't force a re-fetch. Atomic write (temp + fsync + os.replace) is inside refresh_ofac_sdn.py so a mid-write kill can't leave a truncated snapshot for check_data.py to load as empty coverage.
